title: parity-rs tenant routing requests (0.16.0)
description: Requests to a zone's parity-rs on tenant.routing.requests.<zone> (reads only), tenant.routing.ops.requests.<zone> (parity-cc-tools only: every operation) and tenant.routing.onboarding.requests.<zone> (admin-console only: place_tenant with a hint). `x-topics` lists the topics a command is allowed on; on any other it is answered forbidden and changes nothing (authorization is the topic). Every operation carries op_id (one per confirmed operator action), actor and reason; a saga-starting one its saga_id (the idempotency key). CONVENTIONS "Tenant routing API".

cmd_list_routes.description: A page of routes, by tenant id.

cmd_place_tenant.description: Places a new tenant: parity-rs decides from `hint` (onboarding topic) or takes an operator's `target` (ops topic). Exactly one of them. An already placed tenant answers its placement, `changed: false`.

reason.description: Why: shown in the audit and on the saga. No personal data.
